SECTION: P2
CASE CONTEXT: Quickline Parcels (QLP) is a private limited company in the logistics sector, based in Rotterdam, Netherlands, with a workforce of 180. Founded in 2011 by Jasper de Vries, it sorts and delivers parcels for online retailers, and uses democratic leadership with a flat structure in which sorters help set shift targets.…
MARK SCHEME: Basic description of training or recruitment methods with limited application to QLP's quality problem.; Detailed analysis of the benefits and drawbacks of at least two options in the context of QLP's 7% mis-sorts and 22 leavers.; Comprehensive evaluation of all three options in the context of QLP, with a well-justified recommendation covering cost, speed and the specific skills gap.
QUESTION (12 marks): QLP loses 22 of 180 staff each year and 7% of parcels are mis-sorted. Consider on-the-job coaching by senior sorters, off-the-job training at a Rotterdam logistics college, or recruiting quality-control supervisors. Which should QLP choose to cut mis-sorts? Justify your recommendation.
STUDENT ANSWER: On-the-job coaching by senior sorters: Coaching happens on QLP's own floor and uses the real scanners, so workers learn the exact routine behind the 7% mis-sort rate. It is cheap, needs no travel and keeps staff productive.
